description: Launch GCompris and navigate to the Strategy category (chess piece icon). Find and open the 'Tic-Tac-Toe (against the computer)' activity. Play a game against the computer at Level 1 and win (get three in a row). Once you have won and the victory animation/message appears, take a screenshot of the window and save it to '/home/ga/tic_tac_toe_victory.png'.
